# Data for Export-Import Bank Total Direct Sales (1963-1974)
values = [366, 436, 124, 63, 153, 91, 379, 406, 269, 248, 145, 21]

# Sort the values
sorted_values = sorted(values)
print('Sorted values:', sorted_values)

# Calculate median (12 values, so average of 6th and 7th)
median = (sorted_values[5] + sorted_values[6]) / 2
print('Median:', median)

# Value for 1974
value_1974 = 21

# Signed deviation
deviation = value_1974 - median
print('Signed deviation:', deviation)
print('Rounded to 1 decimal:', round(deviation, 1))
"
